Media messages are not supported in this chat
Answers to common questions about chats and app features
How AIChat handles account and message data
Contact support if something does not work correctly

Chats with people and groups support regular messages and supported media attachments. AI chats and random chats are limited to text input, so voice messages, video circles and multimedia buttons are hidden there. Chat badges show the type of conversation, and the large avatar circle shows the latest sender or AI model when this information is available. Appearance, language, notifications, storage and AI model preferences can be changed in settings.

The app stores only the information needed for account access, synchronization, chats, notifications, selected theme, language and local cache. Message history and files can be cached locally to make the interface faster and available after reopening the app. Do not send passwords, verification codes, payment data or other sensitive information in chats. When signing out, local session data is cleared and the app loads fresh chat data after the next sign in.

If something works incorrectly, first check the internet connection, restart the app and make sure the latest version is installed. When contacting support, describe the problem, name the screen where it happened, mention the chat type and add screenshots if possible. This helps reproduce the issue faster and fix it without unnecessary questions.
